start.speaker: Detective
start.text: The board's a mess of red string and doubt. Time to call it. Who killed the man in the alley?

cancel.speaker: Detective
cancel.text: ...Not yet. I want to be sure before I put a name in ink.

win_full.speaker: Detective
win_full.text: He was going to take the docks evidence to the press. Kanzaki cleared his tab to keep him close, then had him silenced. The letter, the matchbook, the paid debt — it all fits. Case closed.

win_partial.speaker: Detective
win_partial.text: Kanzaki's behind it — the paid tab, the enforcer's threat. I can't prove the why, but I know rot when I smell it. Close enough to sign my name to it.

accuse_wrong.speaker: Detective
accuse_wrong.text: ...Maybe. But it doesn't sit right, and it never will. You close the file and let the rain take the rest. That's the job.
